GraceRequirements.Annotation: A local terminal application for recording exercises and workout sets, including repetitions, weight, rest intervals, and workout history, backed by SQLite.
GraceRequirements.Keywords: training, workout logging, exercises, sets, Go, terminal UI, Bubble Tea, SQLite

Goals.Goal: Let an individual record, browse, edit, and delete exercises and workout sets through a keyboard-driven terminal interface with persistent local storage.

Users.User: Individuals tracking their workouts in a terminal.

Constraints.Constraint: Persist workout data locally in SQLite at os.UserConfigDir()/trainlog/trainlog.db. Preserve existing exercise and set validation, weight-unit handling, and transactional writes. Additional product or compliance constraints have not been specified.
